title: Zodiac: A Real-Hardware Testbed and Deterministic Verifier for Agent-Proposed SDN Policy
description:
Zodiac (v3.0.0 Close-Out Release & Technical Whitepaper): A real-hardware testbed and deterministic verifier for agent-proposed Software-Defined Networking (SDN) policy on physical OpenFlow 1.3 silicon.

This archive contains the complete TypeScript deterministic verifier (checks A1–A11), measured microcontroller forwarding cost model (38.5 µs + 34.8 ns/B + 4.24 µs/rule unquarantined; 80.0 µs + 5.42 µs × k under priority-65535 quarantine rules), three-vantage-point passive wire conformance harness (O1, O2, O3), live hardware adversarial suite, 2,920-trial LLM evaluation dataset (Qwen3.8-27B, Gemma 4 26B, Claude Haiku 5.5, and 3B embedded models), and the 26-page technical whitepaper (docs/design/zodiac-whitepaper.pdf).

creators.name: Gravity TPU Infrastructure & Agentic Networking Group
